_note: Sahel, the Coast Edition: garment measurements from the charts Faheem supplied on 27 Oct 2026. S to XL only (we do not make 2XL). Inches as supplied; cm = inches x 2.54, except the hoodie, whose cm figures are as supplied. 31 Oct 2026 (Faheem): the current stock is sold as Super Oversized with a dropped shoulder. teeSuperOversized carries the measurements of the current Sahel tee stock (the chart that was teeOversized); the Sahel Oversized tee fit is being re-cut to the original Founding Edition Oversized size and its chart will be published when it returns. The hoodie chart is now the Super Oversized hoodie chart: the 27 Oct chart with 1.5 inches added to chest, length, shoulder, sleeve and hem at every size (the cuff unchanged), cm = inches x 2.54 to one decimal for the changed values.

teeRegular.label: Sahel tees, Regular fit
teeRegular.intent: A straight regular fit for everyday wear and a classic look.

teeSuperOversized.label: Sahel tees, Super Oversized fit (drop shoulder)
teeSuperOversized.intent: Our roomiest cut, with a dropped shoulder: wide and long through the body. It runs about one size bigger than our Founding Edition Oversized; for the classic oversized look, take one size down.

teeOversized.label: Sahel tees, Oversized fit
teeOversized.intent: A loose, relaxed cut, wider through the body than the Regular fit.
teeOversized._status: Not shown on the site since 31 Oct 2026. These figures belonged to the stock now sold as Super Oversized (teeSuperOversized). Replace with the re-cut Oversized chart when the fit returns.

hoodie.label: Sahel hoodies, Super Oversized fit (drop shoulder)
hoodie.intent: Super Oversized, cut unisex: a dropped shoulder, a roomy chest, relaxed sleeves and a long, loose body. Most people take one size down from their usual size.

method: Chest: garment laid flat, measured straight across 1″ below the armhole. Double it for the full chest.
Length: from the highest point of the shoulder down to the bottom hem.
Shoulder (hoodies): straight across from one shoulder seam to the other.
Sleeve: from the shoulder seam to the sleeve opening.
Hem and cuff (hoodies): the opening measured flat, straight across.

compare.teeRegular: Sahel is cut on its own pattern and runs larger than the Founding Edition: a Sahel Regular S is 22″ across the chest, a Founding Edition Regular S is 19″. Go by the measurement, not the size you took before.
compare.teeSuperOversized: A Sahel Super Oversized S is 24″ across the chest, between a Founding Edition Oversized M (23.5″) and L (25″), so Super Oversized runs about one size bigger than our Founding Edition Oversized.
compare.teeOversized: Sahel is cut on its own pattern and runs larger than the Founding Edition: a Sahel Oversized S is 24″ across the chest, a Founding Edition Oversized S is 22.5″. Go by the measurement, not the size you took before.
compare.hoodie: The hoodies are new to the range, so there is no Founding Edition hoodie to compare with; for reference, a Super Oversized hoodie S is 24.5″ across the chest, a Founding Edition Oversized tee S is 22.5″.
